html_source: 1895 photographic portrait by Pierre-Louis Pierson of Virginia Oldoini, Countess of Castiglione and mistress of Napoleon III, held in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York City. The countess was widely regarded as one of the demimonde. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

1895 photographic portrait by Pierre-Louis Pierson of Virginia
  Oldoini, Countess of Castiglione and mistress of Napoleon III,
  held in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York City. The
  countess was widely regarded as one of the demimonde. Source:
  Wikimedia Commons.
